items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: I know a long time ago before I left he used to have Faso. Yeah, no Faso is dumb or whatever.

ctx.x: Well I asked him did he play with Chris before he played with Jack Carey?

He said did you play with Chris before you played with Jack Carey? Oh yeah, Jack. And I didn't forget who Chris had. Been so long. I know a long time ago before I left he used to have Faso. Yeah, no Faso is dumb or whatever.
